defmodule MonitorAgent.Auth do
  @moduledoc """
  Cross-service authentication module for the monitoring agent.
  Validates service tokens using HMAC-SHA256 with shared secrets.
  """

  @token_ttl_seconds 300
  @max_service_name_length 64

  defstruct [:service_name, :timestamp, :signature, :nonce]

  def verify_service_token(token_string, shared_secrets) do
    with {:ok, parsed} <- parse_token(token_string),
         {:ok, normalized} <- normalize_service_name(parsed),
         :ok <- check_timestamp(normalized.timestamp),
         :ok <- check_nonce(normalized.nonce),
         {:ok, secret} <- lookup_secret(normalized.service_name, shared_secrets),
         :ok <- verify_signature(normalized, secret) do
      {:ok, normalized.service_name}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp parse_token(token_string) do
    case String.split(token_string, "|") do
      [service_name, timestamp_str, nonce, signature] ->
        case Integer.parse(timestamp_str) do
          {timestamp, ""} ->
            {:ok, %__MODULE__{
              service_name: service_name,
              timestamp: timestamp,
              nonce: nonce,
              signature: signature
            }}
          _ -> {:error, :invalid_timestamp}
        end
      _ -> {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  defp normalize_service_name(%__MODULE__{service_name: name} = token) do
    # Normalize Unicode to NFC form for consistent comparison
    normalized = :unicode.characters_to_nfc_binary(name)
    case normalized do
      {:error, _, _} -> {:error, :invalid_unicode}
      bin when is_binary(bin) ->
        if String.length(bin) <= @max_service_name_length do
          {:ok, %{token | service_name: bin}}
        else
          {:error, :name_too_long}
        end
    end
  end

  defp check_timestamp(timestamp) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if abs(now - timestamp) <= @token_ttl_seconds do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :token_expired}
    end
  end

  defp check_nonce(nonce) do
    # Check nonce hasn't been used (simplified - uses ETS in production)
    case :ets.lookup(:nonce_cache, nonce) do
      [] ->
        :ets.insert(:nonce_cache, {nonce, System.system_time(:second)})
        :ok
      _ -> {:error, :nonce_reused}
    end
  end

  defp lookup_secret(service_name, shared_secrets) do
    case Map.get(shared_secrets, service_name) do
      nil -> {:error, :unknown_service}
      secret -> {:ok, secret}
    end
  end

  defp verify_signature(%__MODULE__{} = token, secret) do
    payload = build_payload(token)
    expected = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, secret, payload) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    if expected == token.signature do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp build_payload(%__MODULE__{} = token) do
    "#{token.service_name}|#{token.timestamp}|#{token.nonce}"
  end
end

defmodule MonitorAgent.Logger do
  @moduledoc """
  Structured logging agent that accepts log entries from authenticated services.
  """

  @shared_secrets %{
    "metrics-collector" => "k8s_secret_mc_2024_prod",
    "alert-manager" => "k8s_secret_am_2024_prod",
    "trace-aggregator" => "k8s_secret_ta_2024_prod"
  }

  @log_levels [:debug, :info, :warn, :error, :critical]

  def handle_log_request(token_string, log_entry) do
    case MonitorAgent.Auth.verify_service_token(token_string, @shared_secrets) do
      {:ok, service_name} ->
        process_log(service_name, log_entry)
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, :authentication_failed, reason}
    end
  end

  defp process_log(service_name, %{level: level, message: msg, metadata: meta})
       when level in @log_levels do
    sanitized_msg = sanitize_message(msg)
    entry = %{
      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601(),
      service: service_name,
      level: level,
      message: sanitized_msg,
      metadata: sanitize_metadata(meta)
    }
    write_log(entry)
    {:ok, :logged}
  end

  defp process_log(_service, _entry), do: {:error, :invalid_log_entry}

  defp sanitize_message(msg) when is_binary(msg) do
    msg
    |> String.slice(0, 4096)
    |> String.replace(~r/[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]/, "")
  end
  defp sanitize_message(_), do: ""

  defp sanitize_metadata(meta) when is_map(meta) do
    meta
    |> Map.take(["request_id", "trace_id", "span_id", "host", "pid"])
    |> Enum.into(%{}, fn {k, v} -> {k, to_string(v) |> String.slice(0, 256)} end)
  end
  defp sanitize_metadata(_), do: %{}

  defp write_log(entry) do
    # In production, writes to log aggregation pipeline
    IO.puts(Jason.encode!(entry))
  end
end
